row: Physical Therapy & Sports Medicine Center is a Out-patient physical rehabilitation facilities located in Prince George's County, Montgomery County, and Anne Arundel County Maryland. With clinics in Greenbelt, Riverdale, Bowie, Olney, Rockville, and Glen Burnie, Maryland PTSMC offers treatment plans customized for all patients aches and pains ages 5 and up.  In Network with all Major insurance providers, PTSMC also proudly accepts Medicare, Medicaid, BCBS, Atena, Cigna, Priority Partners,Riverside Health, MCO's, Worker Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents.  Convenient Hours, Free Parking, Bi-Lingual staff.
